issue.title: just docs-check published-URLs gate fails on two links to the nonexistent /bob-command-mode/ page
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `just docs-check` published-URLs gate (`bob-docs urls`)

`just docs-check` in bob-cli fails its published-URLs stage with two broken URL
obligations:

- `docs/guides/run-bob-from-obsidian.md:111` (bob-cli, from 60eb7812/97edc438)
- `docs/develop/plugin-apis.md:267` in bob-plugins (from 6b1b6ec, mounted at
  `develop/plugins/plugin-apis.md`)

Both link `https://bobs-org.github.io/bob-command-mode/`, which is not a built page.
The Bob Command Mode plugin reference is mounted from bob-plugins
`docs/bob-command-mode.md` at `/reference/plugins/bob-command-mode/` (see
`docs/_meta/mounts.yml`), so both links should point there (or use a relative link in
the plugin repo's own docs).

Deterministic: the gate reported `no built page for /bob-command-mode` on the batch-14
lander's run (2026-10-26, after lint and generated drift were cleared), and the
bob-cli-cc lander independently reported the same plugin-apis.md obligation. Owning
epic bob-cli-ce closed at 2026-10-26T19:18Z with the links still in place. Edit both
repos, run `just docs-check` in bob-cli with `BOB_DOCS_BOB_PLUGINS_DIR` pointing at the
bob-plugins checkout, and run `npm run docs:check` in bob-plugins.

Found by the batch-14 lander (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.6.6.land).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The URL resolver reports 'no built page for /bob-command-mode' deterministically; the built page lives at /reference/plugins/bob-command-mode/, and the cc lander reported the same obligation independently.

issue.creation_reason: A deterministic docs-gate failure on master from closed epic bob-cli-ce; every agent's docs-check now stops at it.

payload.description: ce's command-mode docs (60eb7812, 6b1b6ec) added both broken links
